channel.title: Rony Efrat
channel.description: technology is the campfire around which we tell our stories.

item.title: UNE VIE EN FRANCE
item.description: A one-minute biographical series for France Télévisions about figures whose lives reshaped France through migration.

item.title: FAILING FORWARD
item.description: A short fiction film exploring the shifting border between language, family archives and artificial intelligence.

item.title: EXCEPTIONAL TALENT
item.description: A short fiction film set in Paris in 2017, where three migrant women face the arbitrary cancellation of their residence permits.

item.title: TECH, CARE
item.description: A talk on technology, memory and storytelling for researchers, policymakers, artists and communities.

item.title: STRIKE AGAINST THE ARCHIVE
item.description: A multi-screen installation on family memory, national narratives and technology, built from interviews with Rony Efrat’s parents.

item.title: FROM ACCENTS TO AI — On the impact of standardization on identity and linguistic nostalgia
item.description: A talk at Concordia University on language standardization through technology.

item.title: COUP DE CŒUR
item.description: A site-specific video tour for the Historical Library of Paris, created for the European Heritage Days.

item.title: BECOMING MULTILINGUAL
item.description: A workshop on creative translation in theatre and performance through multilingual, collaborative practice.

item.title: ESCALES LIÉES
item.description: IGLOÙ’s 2018 edition brought together artists from different backgrounds between Venice Architecture Biennale and Parc de La Villette.

item.title: TOUT DONNÉES
item.description: IGLOÙ’s second annual event transformed DOC in Paris into a weekend of digital art and multisensory experiences.

item.title: PREMIER SÉJOUR
item.description: The first edition of IGLOÙ gathered artists and writers for a site-specific festival of performance and installation.

item.title: SONIC MUSEUM
item.description: A series of immersive audio guides for the Louvre Museum combining sound, experimental audio and localization.

item.title: CLEFS D’ÂME
item.description: An interactive Exquisite Corpse performance where personal memories are transformed through homophonic translation.

item.title: COINCIDENCE IS A BEAUTIFUL LOVER
item.description: A long-distance storytelling project by Ariel Abrahams and Rony Efrat, created before the collaborators met in person.

item.title: FALSE FRIENDS
item.description: A bilingual performance about faux amis, words that sound alike across languages but carry different meanings.

item.title: FAILURE
item.description: A performance and text on failure, desire and repetition told through fragmented language and the recurring figure of the wolf.

item.title: TRA IL DIRE E IL FARE
item.description: A trilingual performance, three attempts to reach a memory suspended between video, sound and water.

item.title: HOME CHECK
item.description: An interactive performance using digital tools to stage a virtual home visit and explore distance, presence and mediation.
